prompt: The provided Greeter class has a final greet() method that builds its message by calling name(). Complete FrenchGreeter so that overriding ONLY name() changes what greet() says.
explanation: This is the template-method pattern: the final greet() method fixes the overall shape of the message, but delegates one step -- name() -- to a method subclasses may override. Because method calls are dispatched on the runtime type, greet() picks up the FrenchGreeter version of name() even though greet() itself lives in (and is final in) the base class.
hints: You only need to change one method: name(). Do not try to override greet() -- final forbids it.
greet() calls name() on 'this', so at runtime it will call your override automatically.
Return exactly "mon ami" (greet() adds the "Hello, " and "!" parts itself).
